Geographical, climate, and trait data of the Vataireoid legumes

Source: R/data.R
vatsData.Rd

A dataset of 1610 georeferenced, taxonomically vetted herbarium records of the Vataireoid legumes, with climate data (WorldClim) derived from monthly precipitation and temperature model layers. This data frame includes additional continuous and categorical traits, such as DBH, the probability of occurrence in the global succulent biome (Ringelberg et al. 2019), and biome classification (sensu Schrire et al. 2005).

Usage

data(vatsData)

Format

Table in .csv format
